versions.content: Discovering of Entities and Resources Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall support the "‘API Methods for Discovering of Entities and Resources"‘. Rationale: Essential part of the SOVD protocol AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: – Use Case: A client to traverse the topology to find out, which methods can be used for which resources.
